verbatim_snippet: "Domestika doesn't apply commissions or taxes relating to the exchange rate between currencies. However, your bank or payment processor may add an additional fee and so we suggest that you contact them directly to confirm their policy regarding this."
what: Domestika itself charges no exchange rate commissions. Banks/processors may add their own fees.
